rationale: The assistant identified the rear-right zone fault, ranked element versus board as likely causes without overclaiming, and refused to name a part without the full model. It advised an engineer, warned about the burnt smell and gave a booking script. Minor weaknesses: it earlier suggested residual-heat and power-cycle checks, then asked for the label even though the customer said they would not remove the hob. It also left a failed message unaddressed until the customer re-asked, though that was a system error rather than the assistant's fault.
